# Ship Desk & Shipping Integrations

# Ship Desk

The **Ship Desk** is your central hub for managing order fulfilment and shipping. It provides a streamlined queue of orders that are ready to be packed and shipped, with built-in tools for generating shipping labels, fetching carrier rates, and tracking parcels.

---

## Accessing the Ship Desk

Navigate to **Ship Desk** from the main sidebar. The page displays all orders in actionable statuses (by default, orders marked as **Ready**).

### Queue Filters

- **Status filter** — Configure which order statuses appear in the Ship Desk queue (e.g. Pending, Confirmed, In Production, Ready). This is set in your organisation preferences.
- **Location filter** — If you have multiple store locations, filter the queue by origin location.
- **Include pickups** — Toggle whether pickup orders (non-shipping) appear in the queue alongside shipping orders.

### Barcode / Search

The search bar at the top supports **barcode scanning**. Simply scan an order barcode and the Ship Desk will locate the matching order across all non-terminal statuses. You can also type an order number, customer name, or email to search manually.

---

## Creating a Shipment

Click the **Ship** button on any order row to open the shipment wizard. The process follows three steps:

### Step 1 — Origin & Destination

- **Origin address** is pulled from your store locations. If you have a default location it will be pre-selected.
- **Destination address** is pre-filled from the order's shipping details. You can edit it before proceeding.

### Step 2 — Parcels

- Add one or more parcels with dimensions (length × width × height) and weight.
- Use **predefined packages** if you've configured standard box sizes — select one and the dimensions auto-fill.
- All measurements are standardised to **inches** and **ounces** when sent to shipping providers.

### Step 3 — Rates & Label Purchase

- Rates are fetched from your connected shipping provider (EasyPost, Shippo, etc.).
- Select a rate, then click **Buy Label** to purchase the shipping label.
- The label PDF is automatically downloaded and stored.
- If auto-print is configured, the label is sent directly to your PrintNode printer.

---

## Shipping Provider Integrations

OrderHub supports the following shipping providers. You can connect one or more from **Settings → Shipping Providers**.

### EasyPost

[EasyPost](https://www.easypost.com) provides access to a wide range of carriers (USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL, and more) through a single API.

**Setup:**
1. Create an EasyPost account and obtain your **Production API Key** from the EasyPost dashboard.
2. In OrderHub, go to **Settings → Shipping Providers → Connect**.
3. Select **EasyPost**, paste your API key, choose the environment (Test or Production), and save.

### Shippo

[Shippo](https://goshippo.com) is another multi-carrier shipping platform supporting USPS, UPS, DHL Express, and many regional carriers.

**Setup:**
1. Create a Shippo account and copy your **Live API Token** from the Shippo dashboard.
2. In OrderHub, go to **Settings → Shipping Providers → Connect**.
3. Select **Shippo**, paste your API token, choose the environment, and save.

### ShipStation & SendCloud

ShipStation and SendCloud integrations are also available. Both require an **API Key** and **API Secret** which can be found in their respective platform settings.

---

## Auto-Print Labels

When purchasing a label, OrderHub can automatically send the label PDF to a physical printer via **PrintNode**.

To enable auto-printing:

1. Ensure **PrintNode** is set up and active in your organisation settings.
2. When configuring a shipping provider, assign a **Named Printer** (e.g. "Label Printer").
3. Create a **Location → Printer Assignment** that maps the named printer to a physical PrintNode printer at each store location.
4. When a label is purchased for an order originating from that location, it will be sent to the assigned printer automatically.

---

## Order Status Updates

When a shipping label is purchased:

- The **order status** is automatically updated to **Shipped**.
- The **tracking URL** is saved to the order record.
- If you have **order notifications** enabled (email/SMS), a shipped notification is sent to the customer.
- If the order originated from Pixfizz, the Pixfizz platform is also notified of the shipment.

---

## Tracking Sync

Use the **Sync Tracking** button (available when there are trackable shipments) to pull the latest tracking status from the carrier. This updates delivery status for all active shipments.

---

## Pickup Orders

Orders flagged for **in-store pickup** (rather than shipping) also appear in the Ship Desk queue if the "Include pickups" toggle is enabled. For pickup orders, you can send a **Pickup Ready** notification to the customer and then mark the order as complete.

---

## Tips

- Set up **predefined packages** for your most common box sizes to speed up the shipment process.
- Use the **default shipping provider** setting so you don't have to choose a provider each time.
- Configure the Ship Desk statuses in your organisation preferences to match your workflow — for example, include "In Production" if you want to prepare labels in advance.
